content:
Sam Patel: Heads up for tomorrow's orientation at 10:00 AM PT / 6:00 PM BST — I edited the calendar event to include both the Zoom link and the alternative dial-in numbers. Can folks confirm they see 'Zoom - Redwood Orientation' in their invite?
Evelyn Park: I see Zoom and the dial-ins on mine. No passcode. :thumbsup:
Chris O'Neill: Mine shows a blank video field and just says 'Join meeting' with no link. I synced the invite to Outlook desktop earlier.
Sam Patel: Outlook desktop sometimes hides updated attachments from the original invite. Try opening the invite in Outlook web or in Gmail and accept the update. If you already accepted, remove the event and re-accept the latest invite I just sent.
Chris O'Neill: Re-accept fixed it. Zoom appears now. Thanks.
Onboard Bot: Event updated by Sam Patel  Zoom link + dial-in numbers added.
Evelyn Park: Quick note on recordings: we'll record and the recording will be uploaded to our internal drive and linked in #new-hires/resources within an hour. I'll also paste the recording link into the event chat.
Chris O'Neill: If I'm overseas, will the recording be region-restricted? I'm in APAC and sometimes links get blocked by corporate VPN rules.
Sam Patel: It should be accessible internally worldwide. If your corporate network blocks it, try from home network or ping IT Help and they'll create an expiring share link.
IT Help: If anyone needs the recording emailed instead of a Drive link, DM us post-meeting and we'll send an expiring file link.
Evelyn Park: Agenda added to the event description: 1) intros + org map (10m) 2) product roadmap highlights (20m) 3) account/setup troubleshooting + who-to-ask (15m) 4) next steps & resources (15m). Post any setup blockers here and we'll triage live.
Chris O'Neill: I had an MFA prompt stuck during SSO setup earlier. If others hit SSO loops, try clearing cookies or using incognito first, then follow the SSO link from the welcome email.
Sam Patel: Also FYI - if your calendar shows a different time, check that your Google Calendar timezone is correct (some folks have calendar set to UTC instead of local). If you downloaded an ICS into Apple Calendar, it can stubbornly display the original timezone.
Chris O'Neill: macOS Ventura, Apple Calendar, timezone set to JST (UTC+9)  the event initially showed 11:00 for me until I re-accepted.
Sam Patel: For Apple Calendar users: delete any previously imported ICS events and accept the invite via Gmail web or Outlook web so the live link binds correctly. We'll upload a fresh ICS after the session that should import cleanly.
Evelyn Park: We'll pin the cohort roster in #new-hires and include the final ICS with cohort tags after the meeting so people can import without link replacement.
Sam Patel: Great. If anyone still sees weirdness, paste what calendar app/OS and timezone you're on and we'll help before the session. See you all tomorrow! :wave:
